title: Decision enum is closed: no sixth action and no alternate execution route exists
risk: An undocumented decision value or a hidden execute route lets an operator force execution without any of the five controlled decisions, so no control is left.
preconditions: Namespace gov-apv-<case_id>-<worker_id>; approval queue seeded from fixtures/offline/governance.json.
Operator identities and roles resolved from the fixture operator registry; every decision goes through POST /api/v1/approvals/{id}/decision, the only approval route.
APV-CAMP-15 is pending; the gateway route table is enumerable for the tenant.

steps.expected: HTTP 400 with a validation error listing the five accepted values; the item remains AWAITING_HUMAN.
HTTP 404 or 405; no execution is triggered.

steps.action: Attempt to bypass the gate by editing the task status directly
steps.expected: The write is refused and the task state is unchanged; no execution is triggered.

steps.action: Confirm the legitimate path still works
steps.expected: A proper APPROVE decision still releases the task, proving the refusals are not a broken endpoint.

assertions: The decision enum is closed to the five documented values; unknown values are rejected without state change.

Adapter counter is 0 during all three bypass attempts and 1 after the legitimate decision.

Accepting an unknown decision as APPROVE by falling through a switch default.
